Cue 02 — About

Hello, I'm Jiratchaya.

I'm a Creative Concept Designer with a background in Theatre Design and an MA in Art & Project Management, specialising in immersive experiences, spatial storytelling, and concept development.

I create audience-focused visual experiences by combining research, narrative thinking, and creative direction — translating a brief into a clear creative vision before it moves into production.

I've led multidisciplinary projects from initial concept through to delivery, across exhibition design, experiential marketing, and collaborative creative practice.

Concept Development Spatial Storytelling Art Direction Exhibition Design Experiential Marketing
Looking for Concept & experience design roles across the UK and European market.

Cue 04 — Projects

Selected work

01
Alice in Borderlands 3Fans don't just want to watch it — they want to survive it.
+
Challenge

How could Alice in Borderlands Season 3 be promoted through an immersive event experience?

Concept

I reinterpreted the series' survival-game tone into an experiential maze titled "Alice 3," where each section represents a stage the players must face.

Solution

Scenic painting, texture exploration, and projection-mapped light combined handcrafted textures with digital elements, letting audiences interact and feel part of the narrative world.

02
Sweat & TearsEmotional labour, expressed spatially.
+
Challenge

How can emotional states — fatigue, grief, emotional labour — be expressed spatially within an exhibition?

Concept

A solo MA project combining conceptual research, narrative development, and scenographic planning to create an immersive emotional environment.

Outcome

A six-month exhibition, from concept through installation, exploring space as a medium for empathy and reflection.

03
Let's Go Fly a KiteSelf-identity and climate, told through one exhibition.
+
Challenge

How could art help raise awareness of both self-identity and climate issues?

Concept

An exhibition created with Lucy Tomlins as part of the Net Zero Carbon initiative, combining visual storytelling and interactive design with strategic communication.

My role

Internal communicator, website developer, and logo designer for the exhibition's full visual identity.

04
Concept & Spatial ThinkingTwo live briefs, worked through end to end.
+
Brief

Two live event-concept briefs (including "Hydra Heat"), taken from setup and objectives through to concept, colour, and tone.

Focus

Fast, structured concept development — festival identity, mood, and spatial layout, presented the way an agency brief would be pitched back.

05
Seasonal ConceptsHalloween & Christmas, character to set dressing.
+
Brief

Character studies, colour-palette development, and set-dressing concepts for two seasonal immersive installations.

Craft

Backed by scenic painting practice — treating every surface as a narrative layer, not just a finish.
